rmc-1991.notes: rmc-1991 (n=3): the message names no contest date; the counts of teams by problems solved add up to 34. It names sites at Grand Junction and Butte, not Metro State Denver as the catalogue's location has it.

sources.evidence: Google Groups thread 'Regional contest in Mountain Time Zone' in comp.org.acm with the head judge's message of 11 Nov 1991 listing the eight problems and the counts of teams by problems solved.

rmc-1993.notes: Source 2 (archive.org/details/dailyuniverse4768prov): our copy is only the Internet Archive item shell (metadata + JS book reader); the article the catalogue note cites (BYU team second, 29 teams at three locations) is not in it. A capture of the item's full text (the FULL TEXT / djvu.txt download) or the PDF is needed to describe it.

sources.evidence: Our copy is the Internet Archive item page for the Daily Universe of 1993-12-03 (vol. 47 no. 68, 10 pages): catalogue metadata, download links and a book reader that needs JavaScript, with none of the newspaper's text and nothing about a programming contest.
